courses.summary: 阿波馬托克斯是 Shell 深水處理中心；課程以主機設施接受後續連接的假想情境比較容量與可靠度。本課依序分析主機處理餘裕、新增來液熱負荷、主機停機影響範圍、連接距離敏感度、主機與來源資料對帳，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Appomattox is a Shell deepwater hub; a later-tieback scenario compares host capacity and reliability. The course analyses host-processing inventory margin, heat duty of added feeds, consequences of host downtime, tieback-length sensitivity, host-to-source reconciliation, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
